title: A Sofa for My Living Room

sents.t: My apartment is small, but it is nice.
There is a bedroom with a bed and a closet.
In the kitchen, there is a stove, a refrigerator, and a small table with two chairs.
But my living room is empty.
There is no sofa, and there are no lamps.
On Saturday, Rosa says, “Sam, there is a yard sale on Elm Street today. Let’s go!”
A yard sale is very American.
People sell old things in front of their house.
There are tables with clothes, books, toys, plates, and lamps.
At one house, there is a big green sofa.
It is old, but it is clean and comfortable.
“How much is the sofa?” I ask.
“Forty dollars,” the woman says.
“Can you do thirty?” Rosa asks.
The woman smiles.
“OK, thirty dollars.”
There is also a small lamp for five dollars and a picture of the ocean for three.
I buy them too.
Emma’s brother has a truck, and he helps us carry the sofa home.
Now there is a green sofa, a lamp, and a picture in my living room.
Max jumps on the sofa.
He likes it too!

comp.q: How much does Sam pay for the sofa?
comp.fa: سام برای مبل چقدر پول می‌دهد؟

o: the woman at the yard sale
comp.fa: چه کسی در بردن مبل کمک می‌کند؟
